sites.title: Sites or sitemap URLs
sites.description: Domains (sitemap auto-discovered via robots.txt) or direct sitemap URLs, e.g. https://competitor.com or https://competitor.com/sitemap.xml.

trackNewPages.title: Track new pages
trackNewPages.description: Emit a row when a URL appears in the sitemap.

trackRemovedPages.title: Track removed pages
trackRemovedPages.description: Emit a row when a URL disappears from the sitemap.

trackUpdatedPages.title: Track updated pages (lastmod)
trackUpdatedPages.description: Emit a row when a page's lastmod timestamp changes. Uses more snapshot space, so the per-site URL cap tightens to 20,000.

maxUrlsPerSite.title: Max URLs per site
maxUrlsPerSite.description: Snapshot depth per site (large sitemaps are truncated to this).

maxRows.title: Max change rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on change rows returned. Controls total cost.
